evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Is there any specific concern you would like to share or what are you most worried about for the move?' — asked, but only after inventory probing had already run.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised the stairs concern ('two of the rooms currently on the second floor'); rep answered once ('we don't charge extra for the stairs involved') with no second-layer follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you're not bo[u]nd by the estimate' (window framing) and 'preparation... you mentioned earlier you will disassemble the beds in advance, that would really help... the move will take [less] money' (self-prep tip, tied directly to something the customer said).

top_strength: Tied the self-prep tip back to something the customer had already volunteered (disassembling the beds himself), which lands more credibly than a generic script line.
coaching_note: Agenda question lands mid-call instead of up front, and the one concern raised (stairs) gets a single reassurance instead of a real second layer — plus no close attempt at all before the customer says he'll call back later.
